description: Defines the URLRequestTestJob class used for unit testing URL request handling in Chromium, including static methods for test URLs, response data, headers, and control over job execution.

classes.name: URLRequestTestJob
classes.description: A mock URL request job for testing, capable of returning predefined responses, headers, and simulating redirects and errors.

methods.name: URLRequestTestJob
methods.description: Constructs a test job with default or specified response headers and data.

methods.name: test_url_1
methods.description: Returns the URL that automatically advances through each state synchronously.

methods.name: test_url_2
methods.description: Returns a URL that must be manually advanced through each state.

methods.name: test_url_3
methods.description: Returns another URL that must be manually advanced.

methods.name: test_url_4
methods.description: Returns another URL that must be manually advanced.

methods.name: test_url_auto_advance_async_reads_1
methods.description: Returns a URL that automatically advances and reads asynchronously.

methods.name: test_url_error
methods.description: Returns a URL that fails with ERR_INVALID_URL.

methods.name: test_url_redirect_to_url_1
methods.description: Returns a URL redirecting to test_url_1.

methods.name: test_url_redirect_to_url_2
methods.description: Returns a URL redirecting to test_url_2.

methods.name: test_headers
methods.description: Returns headers for the test URLs.

methods.name: ProcessOnePendingMessage
methods.description: Processes one pending message in the test job queue.

methods.name: IsRedirectResponse
methods.description: Checks if response is a redirect.
